contract: AKM Auto Consult landing — motor claim management + inspection + settlement platform; audience = customer, staff, admin, partner; job = communicate workflow (claims -> inspection -> estimate -> settlement) immediately; constraints = Tailwind v4, dark/light via .dark, proxy.ts middleware, AVIF audit links, server-only auth, responsive, a11y, 0 fixtures.
direction: Purpose: operational dashboard landing (dense, scannable, quiet — not marketing). Audience: staff repeating claim workflow; customer checking status. Tone: refined, technical, calm (industrial teal + muted slate). Memorable detail: subtle 48px geometric grid behind hero (echoes claim-tracking timeline); cards use border + card token (not shadow-heavy tiers). Constraints respected (Tailwind CSS-first, no new dependencies, getAppName() title, responsive).

loading.evidence: Suspense skeleton not needed for static landing; stable layout

empty.reason: DB not required for landing; shown explicitly (public, no fixtures)

error.reason: Static landing has no data fetch; client error boundary handled globally (global-error.tsx)

partial.evidence: Cards shown unconditionally; no partial state needed

success.evidence: Portal cards visible; access-note clearly states deny-by-default

permission.reason: Public landing shown generically; protected routes redirect generically (proxy/auth, not UI hiding)

accessibility.evidence: Semantic <main> + <section> + <article>; aria-label on all regions; keyboard nav via native <a> + focus-visible ring; reduced-motion via prefers-reduced-motion in CSS

responsive.evidence: Mobile narrow (375px) 1-col stack with long-label wrapping; desktop wide (1440px) 3-col grid; sticky nav avoids overflow; tested at target viewports
